scope: claim-level AI-chat evidence acceptance, citation integrity, freshness, source authority, independence and contradiction handling
invariants: citation proximity alone never counts as evidence
citation integrity must pass before a source counts toward support
freshness-required claims reject missing stale or future timestamps
authoritative-source claims fail closed for disallowed source classes
high-assurance claims require independent supporting evidence
accepted contradicting evidence blocks release by default
rejected sources never count toward support thresholds
claim evidence decisions are deterministic and digest bound
promotion_rule: implemented candidate only; exact-head regression and independent verification must pass before qualification
